Overview

Rutland is a city in VT with a population of 16,000. Central Vermont’s largest city with Killington ski access and a historic downtown. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews older, with a median age of 48.5.
